subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup path, and what secret-bearing auth handoff is acceptable?
rationale: The request adds new provider-auth and env/config surface around OAuth callback material, which is security-sensitive and not already supplied as a stable upstream Codex callback import contract.

options.title: Design Safer Auth Handoff
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved plugin-owned non-interactive handoff that validates PKCE/state and minimizes callback URL exposure before documenting and testing it.

options.title: Accept Callback URL Env
options.body: Support an env callback import only with explicit validation, redaction, docs, and upgrade/security proof for logs, shells, and CI contexts.

options.title: Defer To Existing Flows
options.body: Keep API-key, interactive browser/manual paste, and device-code as the supported setup surfaces until upstream Codex exposes a safer non-interactive contract.

recommendation.title: Design Safer Auth Handoff
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved plugin-owned non-interactive handoff that validates PKCE/state and minimizes callback URL exposure before documenting and testing it.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this account to the non-interactive provider setup path and OpenAI provider identity/auth surface involved in the decision.
